content: Allowed docs only come from code_exact; two real PG-verified explicit amendment targets are rejected from local candidates. Preserve proven explicit attribution without loosening self-code or version restrictions.

Table fragment paths lose unit/table ID and citation. Actual fact-002 yields two identical PG path dictionaries for different physical fragments; retain each original source binding and typed-target metadata.

Current-query service receipts never populate failed_receipts. PG reread failure after local success produces a zero-service failure terminal. Gold guard refusal at line 503 also escapes the terminal writer.

Production identity capture runs before config validation at line 534. A forbidden QDRANT_WORKSPACE override causes two backend captures before refusal; validate all requested configurations locally first.
